title: Director, Program Management
Director, Technical Program Management
description:
About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is looking for a director to help lead GitHub’s Technical Program Management team in our Engineering organization. You should be an ambitious, passionate, technical, and collaborative leader with a strong background in empowering high performing teams and an ability to deliver results through technical programs. 


The Director, TPM will strengthen TPM's role as a trusted integrator, driving clarity, accountability, and execution across complex, cross-functional initiatives. They will help teams frame problems, align stakeholders, and accelerate decision-making while raising the effectiveness of TPMs and scaling their influence across the company. This director will foster a culture of ownership, bias for action, and operational excellence, ensuring execution remains tightly aligned with strategic priorities. 


Responsibilities

Opportunity and Solutions Identification 

  • Demonstrates and builds experiences across multiple groups or divisions. Leads and coaches teams to develop problem statements and form hypotheses for products and services across divisional boundaries to address highly complex business, program, customer needs, and/or market opportunities; identifies dependencies of other features. 

  • Determines and leads process improvements to quickly scope insights, and drives change management initiatives. Uses industry understanding to direct teams to ensure alignment between the customer, the market, internal stakeholders, senior leadership, and the goals and strategy of GitHub. 

  • Holds teams accountable for collaborating with others (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Design) to ensure that they can satisfy customer requirements. Provides expertise to help teams validate the market size and opportunity of greatest value for the company. Facilitates collaboration between their team and other partner teams to bring about solutions. 

 

Program Planning and Success 

  • Provides expertise to help teams define the multiple program goals and prioritization for the products and services they own. Guides teams to translate the needs of the organization and other teams into program goals and prioritize deliverables based on data insights.  

  • Guides teams to engage in active risk management (proactive and reactive) to identify risks and propose mitigations for risks using data (e.g., telemetry, usage, net satisfaction, customer satisfaction). 

  • Coaches teams to define success criteria and performance metrics (e.g., Objectives and Key Results [OKRs], Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as quality and performance) of products, services and works with engineering to ensure needed telemetry is developed. Provides expert knowledge to help teams deeply understand the return on investment. 

  

Program/Service Development 

  • Acts as a subject matter expert in orchestrating and integrating efforts for the development and implementation process of product, services on large cross functional projects with internal teams and external partners. Drives teams to collaborate and coordinate across teams and perspectives to ensure alignment on product management and release, including tradeoffs, adjustments, and improvements as feasible. 

  • Guides teams to partner with the engineering team to contribute, prioritize, and deliver on the roadmap for product, service. Drives teams to understand the value proposition for the feature(s)/feature areas and answer technical questions on the feature(s)/feature areas they own.  

  • Guides teams to justify capacity requirements and advocate for the right resource allocation. Partners with the Engineering team to know the feature capabilities in alignment with the goal updates and associated tradeoffs. 

  • Guides teams tracking, coordinating, and communicating end-to-end project schedules for products, services. Ensures teams establish and monitor processes, and hold other stakeholders accountable for following the established schedule and processes. 

  • Guides teams when tracking and managing dependencies to enable cohesive, connected user scenarios, and to avoid issues and mitigate risks. Coaches teams to make adjustments or course corrections when projects are not aligned to schedules or goals. 

  • Drives teams to develop the staging and implementation plan for piloting/release in alignment with Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for products, services, its development timeline, and the introduction to the different programs. Ensures teams collaborate with stakeholders to monitor progress and adjust as needed. 

  • Helps teams lead governance programs and processes to ensure that specific performance requirements and standards are met throughout the development lifecycle (e.g., quality, compliance, privacy, security, safety, accessibility). 

 

Continuous Improvement 

  • Provides expertise to help teams partner with others to collect performance metrics (e.g., Key Performance Indicators [KPIs] such as usage, quality, speed, and cost), monitor and report on progress (e.g., business reviews), and derive insights that lead to productive courses of action. 

  • Ensures teams share insights with Engineering and other partners. Leads teams to form hypotheses to technical needs, perform experiments, and iterate to drive improvement in specific performance metrics that have measurable impact. 


Qualifications

Required Qualifications 

  • 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 4+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years experience in managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects. 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development

    • OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 10+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 8+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR Doctorate in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Math, Business, or related field AND 6+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years people management experience.
  • 4+ years experience designing, building, or supporting software systems. 

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $140,400.00 - USD $372,300.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Description

The Sr Mgr Product Management-Tech will drive forward-looking product strategy and new initiatives for Amazon’s tablet portfolio. This leader will own the vision for exciting future programs, translating emerging customer needs and technology trends into compelling product concepts that influence to our multi-generational roadmap. You will work at the intersection of hardware, software, and services—partnering across engineering, design, and business teams to bring transformative products from concept through successful launch.

We’re seeking an exceptional product leader with a proven track record of envisioning and delivering innovative consumer electronics products at scale. You have successfully planned and launched products that customers love—ideally in tablets, phones, and mobile platforms. You bring deep experience in product planning across multiple product generations, a strong technical foundation that enables you to partner effectively with engineering teams, and the ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into clear product strategies. You thrive in fast-paced environments where you must balance long-term vision with disciplined execution, and you have a demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment across complex, matrixed organizations.

Key job responsibilities

- Identify opportunities that leverage emerging technologies, evolving customer behaviors, and market trends

- Lead product planning for future programs from concept through launch, including defining product requirements, making trade-off decisions, and driving alignment across hardware, software, and services teams

- Develop compelling product visions and strategies that articulate where the tablet category is headed and how Amazon will win, influencing VP and Director-level stakeholders

- Contribute to end-to-end product development and successful product launches, partnering with engineering, design, operations, and go-to-market teams to deliver on time and at quality

- Translate deep customer insights, competitive intelligence, and technology trends into actionable product strategies that shape multi-generational planning

- Own key business metrics and success criteria for future programs, using data-driven analysis to inform investment priorities and product decisions

- Contribute to the broader Devices product strategy by identifying cross-portfolio opportunities and driving innovation that scales beyond tablets

- Mentor product managers and build organizational capability through thought leadership and raising the bar on product excellence

- Bring a strong technical foundation, with a solid understanding of both hardware and software

Basic Qualifications

- 6+ years of team management experience

- Bachelor's degree

- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

- 8+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience

- Experience with end to end product delivery

- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment

- Experience working directly with Engineers on product enhancements

- Experience in project management methodologies, business analysis, or process improvement

description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role

Crusoe is scaling one of the fastest-growing global workplace and data center portfolios in the industry, with active real estate initiatives spanning San Francisco, Denver, London, Tel Aviv, Bellevue, and beyond, alongside a rapidly expanding global data center footprint. We're looking for a Senior Director, Real Estate & Portfolio Strategy to lead the strategy, execution, and financial management of our global co-location, manufacturing office and data center lease portfolio.

Reporting directly to the VP, DIG Operations, this role will be a critical partner in aligning our real estate strategy with business growth, headcount planning, employee experience, and long-term financial objectives across both corporate office, co-location, manufacturing and data center real estate. You'll work closely with our exclusive global brokerage partner, Legal, Finance, People, Data Center Operations, and business leaders to deliver thoughtful, data-driven real estate solutions that support Crusoe's continued expansion.

This is an exciting opportunity for a senior real estate leader who thrives on managing multiple concurrent transactions across office, manufacturing and data center/colocation portfolios, enjoys the financial and analytical side of commercial real estate, and wants to build scalable portfolio strategies, lease governance, and audit processes for a rapidly growing global company.

 

What You'll Be Working On

 

• Portfolio Strategy and Asset Management: by partnering with Finance, People, Workplace, and Data Center Operations leadership to translate hiring forecasts, capacity plans, and space/power utilization into real estate recommendations. Evaluate expansion, consolidation, renewal, and exit opportunities across global office and data center markets.

• Lease Portfolio Management: own the master lease abstract database across all locations, tracking key dates, terms, options, renewal windows, and obligations to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

• Lease Review & Abstracting: lead comprehensive lease review and abstracting for new and existing leases, including manufacturing office, data center, and cloud colocation agreements — abstracting key business, financial, and legal terms into standardized formats for portfolio-wide tracking and reporting.

• Transaction Execution: manage end-to-end real estate transactions — including new office and manufacturing leases, renewals, subleases, expansions, contractions, and terminations — in close partnership with our brokers and legal counsel.

• Cloud Colocation & Data Center Lease Management: lead ongoing lease management for cloud colocation and data center leases, including power/capacity commitments, service level agreements, interconnection terms, expansion rights, and hyperscaler lease administration.

• Critical Date Management: own the tracking and management of all critical lease dates across the portfolio — including notice periods, renewal and termination options, rent escalations, expansion/contraction windows, and compliance deadlines — ensuring proactive action ahead of key milestones.

• Financial Analysis & Reporting: build and maintain cash flow models, occupancy cost analyses, rent schedules, lease comparisons, escalations, and CAM reconciliations to support executive decision-making across office, manufacturing and data center portfolios.

• Executive Reporting: prepare business cases, portfolio updates, and executive presentations that translate complex lease and financial data into clear, actionable recommendations for executive leadership.

• Stakeholder Coordination: serve as the primary point of contact between Workplace, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Data Center Operations, and site leadership on all lease-related matters, including purchase order and approval workflows in Coupa.

• Broker & Transaction Management: serve as the relationship manager for Crusoe's global brokerage partner, leading lease negotiations, coordinating transaction strategy, and driving favorable business and financial outcomes across the portfolio.

• Compliance, Risk & Audit Management: track insurance requirements, certificates of occupancy, permits, and critical lease obligations across office and data center locations; manage lease and portfolio audits, proactively identifying and mitigating portfolio risks.

• Site Selection: partner with brokers and internal stakeholders on new market evaluations, including market analysis, site tours, financial comparisons, and lease execution for both office and manufacturing sites.

• Portfolio Systems & Process Improvement: lead the evaluation and implementation of a global lease administration platform while continuously improving portfolio reporting, documentation, and governance — including audit readiness — to support Crusoe's continued growth.

 

What You'll Bring to the Team

• Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance, or a related field.

• 15+ years of experience in corporate real estate, portfolio strategy, lease administration, or commercial real estate transaction management, including experience with data center or cloud colocation leasing.

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent lease transactions across multiple geographies and asset types, including office and data center/colocation.

• Strong financial acumen, including developing business cases, cash flow projections, occupancy cost analyses, lease economics, and executive recommendations.

• Hands-on experience with lease review, abstracting, and management, including tracking of critical dates, options, and obligations across a large, complex portfolio.

• Experience negotiating commercial lease terms in partnership with brokers and legal counsel, including colocation and data center-specific terms (power, SLAs, interconnection, expansion rights).

• Experience leading or supporting lease and portfolio audits, with a strong understanding of compliance and risk management practices.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing cross-functional partners and executive leadership without direct authority.

• Experience implementing or administering lease management software is highly desirable.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets with strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex real estate and financial information for executive audiences.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with evolving business priorities.

 

Bonus Points

• Experience in a high-growth technology, AI, data center, or manufacturing environment.

• Experience working directly with a global brokerage firm (e.g., JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield).

• Experience supporting international real estate transactions and global portfolios.

• Direct experience with hyperscaler or wholesale data center lease structures and negotiations.

Employer contributions to HSA account

Cell phone stipend

401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

Volunteer time off

Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

Daily meals allowance

Additional perks & programs specific to location

 

Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $235,000 -$285,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicants knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub's Pull Request Platform powers one of the most critical developer workflows in the world. Every pull request operation across GitHub.com, the API, and GitHub Enterprise Server depends on the systems this team owns. The team is responsible for pull request state, mergeability, indexing, automation, and platform reliability, serving tens of millions of developers who collaborate, review code, and ship software every day. 

 

We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead Pull Request Platform through a period of significant technical investment. The team is strengthening production reliability in a complex, high-traffic area, contributing to GitHub's service-extraction efforts, and evolving its infrastructure to meet growing scale requirements. You'll join our Core Productivity organization and directly influence the reliability and performance of one of GitHub's most visible and heavily used features. 

 

As a staff engineer, you'll be a hands-on technical leader who shapes architecture, guides complex initiatives, and helps the team turn ambiguous problems into durable solutions. You'll work across Git operations, databases, search, APIs, and asynchronous workflows while helping define the platform's longer-term technical direction. 

 

This work blends distributed systems experience with pragmatic execution — moving between writing and reviewing code, leading architectural decisions, improving production systems, and building alignment across organizational boundaries. You'll partner closely with Pull Request Experience, Repositories Platform, Git Systems, and other teams across GitHub while mentoring engineers and helping the team grow its technical practices. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and evolution of systems that power pull requests at GitHub scale. 

  • Help define and execute the Pull Request Platform technical roadmap, aligning engineering investments with GitHub’s reliability, scalability, and service-extraction priorities. 

  • Solve complex technical challenges spanning Git operations, databases, search and indexing, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. 

  • Design, develop, test, and ship maintainable solutions that operate across multiple GitHub services. 

  • Own and advocate for the health of the team’s production systems, including participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident improvements. 

  • Set high standards for operational safety, testing, observability, deployment practices, and production rollouts. 

  • Write architecture briefs and technical proposals, conduct code experiments, and clearly communicate tradeoffs and operational risks. 

  • Partner across engineering teams to define scalable interfaces, reduce system friction, and lead initiatives such as service extraction and platform hardening. 

  • Provide technical leadership through mentorship, pairing, code and design reviews, and guidance that helps other engineers deliver extensible, maintainable systems. 

  • Improve engineering and operational excellence through automation, tooling, and standardization across testing, deployment, and operations. 

 


Qualifications

    • OR equivalent experience
       

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • 1+ years' experience developing software in Ruby and/or Go. 

  • 1+ years’ experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems or platform infrastructure with demanding reliability and performance requirements. 

  • 1+ years’ experience diagnosing and improving the scalability, observability, resilience, and performance of high-traffic production systems.

About GitHub

GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot.

Locations

In this role you can work from Remote, United States

Overview

GitHub is seeking a Staff Developer Advocate to join the GitHub Security Lab. The mission of the Security Lab is to inspire and enable the community to secure the open source software we all depend on. We create a home for security researchers where they can collaborate and share, with the common goal of making security easy for developers.


In this role, you will act as a known subject matter expert and trusted ambassador who engages with security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise developers and encourages them to get the most out of GitHub Security Lab's security tools and resources — including CodeQL, Dependabot, secret scanning, code scanning, Copilot Autofix, AI-powered vulnerability detection, and the GitHub Advisory Database.


You will define the vision and strategy for the Security Lab's developer advocacy program, producing high-quality technical content (blog posts, tutorials, training, videos, CTFs, conference talks), leading community events, and driving social media campaigns. You will grow our community from a dedicated group of security enthusiasts to everyone who cares about software security. You will also help the security community understand and navigate the evolving intersection of AI and security — from securing AI-generated code to leveraging AI for vulnerability discovery.


As a Staff-level advocate, you bring cross-team influence and deep technical expertise across multiple areas. You don't just execute — you set direction, establish frameworks that help others produce great security content, and proactively identify highly impactful unaddressed issues, mobilizing resources to resolve them before they affect the community. You mentor and sponsor others within the team, and you use data and business outcomes to inform decisions and influence stakeholders across GitHub.


Responsibilities

Understanding the Security Community

Acts as a known subject matter expert of the security research and open source developer communities — their common experiences, goals, industry trends, and key developments — by meeting with community members, attending security and developer conferences, and engaging on social media. Possesses expert knowledge of GitHub's security products and services (CodeQL, code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot, advisory database) and their potential impact on the broader security ecosystem. Strategically seeks out influencers in the security and open source spaces to understand business drivers and community objectives. Anticipates future changes in the application security landscape, including the impact of AI on security research workflows and the emerging challenges of securing AI-generated code.

Building Trusted Relationships

Acts as a trusted and influential ambassador between the security community and GitHub's product, engineering, and marketing teams. Builds and maintains a broad, diverse network across security researchers, open source maintainers, and enterprise security teams. Utilizes deep understanding of community needs to share valuable insights, best practices, and technical know-how, maintaining thought leadership within the security community.

Internal Advocacy and Impact

Collects and seeks out feedback from the security community and stakeholders regarding product usage, user experience, and technical issues. Communicates clearly and effectively to relevant product groups, advocating for and influencing urgent and long-term improvements to GitHub's security features. Proactively builds and manages networks of key stakeholders and leads engagement through established and informal channels to provide feedback on priorities and emerging security scenarios. Incorporates data and key metrics into findings regarding value-add and impact of advocacy initiatives. Ensures the feedback loop between community members, the Security Lab, and the GitHub product team is effective.

Supporting Key Internal Initiatives

Builds and enhances trust with internal teams through networking and engagement regarding security product improvement plans. Acts as a subject matter expert for internal stakeholders on application security and the security researcher community. Regularly engages in retrospective evaluations to inform future work.

Content Development

Defines, creates, and leads the technical content strategy for the Security Lab — blog posts, tutorials, training courses, videos, CTFs, puzzles, and conference talks — covering topics from traditional vulnerability research to AI-assisted security analysis and secure AI development practices. Drives interactions across technical forums, social media, and community channels to promote awareness and provide best practices. Represents the GitHub Security Lab at high-visibility security and developer conferences, hackathons, and meetups. Sets the standard for content quality and measures impact to continuously improve how we communicate with the security community.

Community Impact

Actively seeks out feedback and listens to the needs of the security community, responding with relevant information and upskilling others to make a substantial impact on community growth. Designs the community member journey — from first engagement to active contributor — measuring retention and engagement along the way. Proposes strategic improvements to the community experience. Manages the Security Lab's social media presence and public forums. Applies deep knowledge of GitHub's security products, stakeholders, and strategic objectives to influence and inspire the audience.

Technical Expertise

Possesses deep technical expertise in application security, secure code practices, vulnerability research, AI-assisted code analysis, and static analysis. Constantly seeks out learning and teaching opportunities and engages in conversations with key security researchers and developers to understand current developments and issues. Applies and practices technical expertise via sample code, CodeQL queries, security advisories, and demonstrations. Builds processes and systems to share technical expertise at scale and works within the industry to help inform future security developments. Understands the security implications of AI-generated code and AI-powered development tools, and can communicate best practices for secure AI adoption to both security researchers and developers. Gains broader knowledge of adjacent technologies and incorporates them into current areas of expertise.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years experience in community/audience engagement, information technology, software development, or related work
    • OR Bachelor's Degree AND 8+ years experience in community/audience engagement, information technology, software development, or related work
    • OR equivalent experience
  • Delivered at least one technical keynote on a security topic at a developer conference with 1,000+ attendees
    • OR delivered a session at a major security conference (Black Hat, DEF CON, etc)
    • OR published regular content (blog, podcast) on security and open source topics
  • 2+ years of experience in application security, secure code practices, or vulnerability research
    • OR 2+ years of experience in a Developer Advocacy function on application security, secure code practices, or vulnerability research topics
    • OR contributions to open source security projects or security-focused open source tools
  • 4+ years of experience working with Git, GitHub, and software development practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • 13+ years experience in community/audience engagement, information technology, software development, public speaking, technical writing, or related work
    • OR Bachelor's Degree AND 11+ years experience in community/audience engagement, information technology, software development, public speaking, technical writing, or related work
    • OR equivalent experience
  • 2+ years of experience with static analysis tools like CodeQL
  • 2+ years of active participation in security communities
    • OR 2+ years of active participation in open source maintainer communities with a focus on security
    • OR 2+ years of mentoring or teaching application security, secure code practices, or vulnerability research
  • At least one public contribution (content, open source tooling) on AI/ML security topics — such as securing AI-generated code, AI-assisted vulnerability discovery, or red-teaming LLM-based tools

Compensation Range

The base salary range for this job is USD $121,800.00 - USD $323,200.00 /Yr.

These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role.

This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

GitHub values

  • Customer-obsessed
  • Ship to learn
  • Growth mindset
  • Own the outcome
  • Better together
  • Diverse and inclusive

Manager fundamentals

  • Model
  • Coach
  • Care

Leadership principles

  • Create clarity
  • Generate energy
  • Deliver success

Who We Are

GitHub is the world’s leading AI-powered developer platform with 150 million developers and counting. We’re also home to the biggest open-source community on earth (and 99% of the world’s software has open-source code in its DNA). Many of the apps and programs you use every day are built on GitHub.
Our teams are dreamers, doers, and pioneers, leading the way in AI, driving humanitarian efforts around the globe, and even sending open source to Mars (and beyond!). At GitHub, our goal is to create the space you need to do your best work. We’re remote-first and offer competitive pay, generous learning and growth opportunities, and excellent benefits to support you, wherever you are—because we know that people flourish when they can work on their own terms.
Join us, and let’s change the world, together.

EEO Statement

GitHub is made up of people from a wide variety of backgrounds and lifestyles. We embrace diversity and invite applications from people of all walks of life. We don't discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, pregnancy status, veteran status, or any other differences. Also, if you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

description:
About the Role

As our organization scales, we are fundamentally transforming how we deliver value to our customers. Introducing our advanced robots into dynamic, unstructured environments requires a seamless, enterprise-grade support ecosystem.

Reporting directly to the VP of Customer Experience, the Director of CX Strategy and Portfolio Management will pioneer our shift to treating Customer Experience (CX) as a formalized product. In this role, you will own the strategic roadmap and manage a complex portfolio of initiatives designed to mature the entire CX lifecycle from onboarding and deployment through service, and support. Crucially, this is an inherently non-siloed, connective function; success demands radical, deep-seated collaboration across every single pillar of the business—integrating CX, Sales, Marketing, Product, and Engineering into one unified, high-velocity engine.

Key Responsibilities

CX Vision and Strategy

This leader will be responsible for four pillars of creating the world's best Customer Experience engine for the world's most advanced unstructured robotic solutions:

Pillar I: CX Product Innovation & Customer Obsession

Product Leadership: Directly manage one Product Manager to productize the end-to-end customer journey with the same rigor as hardware development.

Zero-Friction Mandate: Drive the strategy for "zero friction" scores by translating customer obsession into actionable product requirements and seamless onboarding experiences.

Pillar II: Portfolio & Technical Program Delivery

TPM Management: Lead and mentor a team of three Technical Program Managers (TPMs) to oversee the execution of the CX strategic roadmap.

Serviceability & Scale: Focus the TPM team on maturing legacy systems, improving serviceability, and deploying introspective tooling that enables the CX organization to scale globally.

Pillar III: Strategic CX Integration & Alignment

Executive Partnership: Serve as the primary strategic partner to the VP of Customer Experience, translating high-level vision into actionable, enterprise-wide strategy.

Cross-Functional Synergy: Drive organizational alignment across departmental silos, managing stakeholder relationships to ensure unified outcomes across the entire CX lifecycle.

Pillar IV: Rapid Prototyping & AI/Enterprise Tooling

Dev Team Leadership: Manage a small, dedicated scrum team of developers to rapidly prototype internal tools and advanced CX capabilities.

Tooling Ownership: Own the incubation and iteration of AI initiatives and enterprise tools (e.g., Salesforce) through to the point of handover to the BizOps team.

BizOps Collaboration: Partner closely with BizOps Data Science and BizOps PMO teams to ensure technical prototypes are scalable and data-driven before full enterprise integration.

Qualifications & Key Attributes

Experience: 15+ years of leadership experience in Product Management, Portfolio/Program Management, or CS Strategy, ideally within a scaling B2B technology, hardware, or robotics company.

Methodology Mastery: Deep fluency in product management methodologies (Agile, journey mapping, discovery frameworks) and portfolio management best practices (governance, resource leveling, strategic road mapping).

Systems Architecture & Scaling: A proven track record of taking immature operational processes and scaling them into robust, enterprise-grade systems capable of supporting complex, global deployments.

Change Management Expertise: Demonstrated experience leading large-scale organizational change (e.g., ADKAR or similar frameworks). Excellence in bringing disparate stakeholders together and leading through influence without direct authority.

Customer Obsession & Analytics: A relentless drive to advocate for the user, coupled with the analytical acumen to translate qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics into actionable product requirements.

Exceptional Communication: The ability to seamlessly translate complex operational realities between deep technical engineering teams and customer-facing service personnel.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.

The base pay range for this position is between $195,000 to $255,000 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors including, but not limited to internal equity, job related knowledge, skills and experience.  This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and an annual bonus structure.  Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

Principal TPM, Enterprise Engineering 

Job ID: 10570635 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Enterprise Engineering builds and operates the internal tools, platforms, and AI-powered services that enable over 1.5 million Amazonians to do their best work every day — from endpoint management and collaboration to innovative productivity experiences, all at massive global scale. We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact, cross-functional, company wide projects. This role requires working closely with product management to define strategy and requirements, collecting business and systems requirements from customers and business units, writing specifications, and leading development teams from design through delivery and subsequent operation. You will be expected to make appropriate trade-offs to optimize launch timelines, clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to internal cross-functional project teams. This position involves regular communication with senior management on status, risks, and product strategy. Excellent listening, writing skills, executive communication and very strong technical competency are essential.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects through multiple complete product development cycles, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current technologies. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an entrepreneurial environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces, develop detailed functional and test specifications, schedule, and deploy new feature sets in a successful and timely manner is expected. Maturity, high product judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent, and leadership are essential to success in this role. 

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of software development experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

Principal TPM - Privacy, Regulation Tech & Assurance 

Job ID: 10566210 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Regulation Tech Assurance (RTA) is the team responsible for maintaining global regulatory compliance for all Amazon Stores, Devices, and Others to include payment and healthcare compliance. Additionally, RTA works to identify, analyze, and mitigate privacy risk identified through various compliance activities. 

We are seeking an experienced, self-motivated Principal Technical Program Manager with a background in privacy governance who will help identify, analyze, and prioritize privacy risk identified through a variety of sources across Amazon. This work will help drive leadership prioritization and reduced privacy compliance risk. The Principal Technical Program Manager will drive the strategy and manage the Hourglass program, which focuses on identifying, assessing, and remediating privacy obligations across all of Amazon. 

Key job responsibilities

- Drive end-to-end strategy and execution of Amazon Privacy's identification, assessment, and remediation framework for privacy obligations. 

- Manage and be accountable for privacy programs and/or projects to reduce privacy and compliance risk. 

- Work across various stakeholders to identify and evaluate customer needs and solutions.

- Lead various privacy compliance activities in order for Amazon to achieve and maintain compliance with legal, policy, and regulatory standards. 

- Continuously prioritize risk for service teams, security teams, and executive leadership.

- Work with Principal Engineers and others to develop technical risk mitigation strategies and approaches. 

- Communicate clearly and effectively both in writing and verbally with team members, stakeholders, and leadership.

- Integrate into various enterprise risk management processes.

- Establish program mechanisms, KPIs, and executive reporting.

About the team

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

Preferred Qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- 5+ years of HR, privacy, legal, compliance or risk management experience

Within AAIS, Amazon WorkSpaces is our cloud-based virtual desktop service that delivers secure, managed computing to over one million daily users across the globe, enabling organizations to provision, manage, and scale desktops with the reliability and performance their workforce depends on.



We are now at an inflection point. We are transforming traditional virtual desktops into Agentic WorkSpaces a new category of intelligent persona driven workspace experiences where AI agents operate continuously alongside humans orchestrating across foundation models maintaining enterprise governance and unlocking productivity at scale. This transformation spans multiple strategic pillars from next generation architecture modernization to AI powered capacity intelligence to entirely new product constructs all converging toward a single mission: making WorkSpaces the definitive venue for human AI teamwork in the enterprise.



We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the lifecycle of the most complex cross organizational programs driving this transformation. You will manage multiple concurrent workstreams spanning capacity intelligence, architecture modernization, agentic AI integration, persona-driven workspace experiences, and new product incubation stitching together a coherent narrative for executive leadership while proactively identifying and mitigating risk across every dimension.



This is not a role for someone who waits for problems to surface. You will operate at the intersection of deep technical understanding methodical program execution and executive influence driving clarity where ambiguity exists building mechanisms that scale cross functionally and establishing trust with VPs and SVPs across AWS and AAIS leadership.

Key job responsibilities

• Multi-Workstream Program Ownership Own end to end delivery of significantly complex cross functional technical initiatives spanning multiple organizations across science engineering product business and data engineering. Drive simultaneous workstreams including agentic AI integration, workspace persona experiences, architecture modernization, capacity forecasting and optimization, and new product incubation with clear dependencies milestones and accountability. Stitch together disparate workstream narratives into a unified coherent story for leadership reviews QBRs and S Team updates.

• Proactive Risk Identification and Mitigation Develop mechanisms to surface risk early: capacity gaps service dependencies migration blockers science to production handoff delays and timeline slips before they escalate. Own escalation paths and drive resolution at the right level. You are escalated to, not escalating up. Build data driven risk models that quantify trade offs between investment timing technical debt and customer experience informing executive decision making with precision rather than intuition.

• Technical Depth and Influence Understand system architectures deeply enough to challenge engineering teams spot risks in technical proposals and drive simplification across a portfolio that spans ML inference pipelines agent orchestration frameworks desktop streaming protocols and distributed infrastructure. Evaluate capacity plans scaling signals and architecture trade offs with confidence. Influence design decisions across service teams to unblock innovation accelerate delivery and ensure that science driven capabilities translate into production impact.

About the team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.



Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.



We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.



Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.



We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

 

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

 

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

Staff Tech Portfolio Manager, Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS)

About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused Staff Tech Portfolio Manager to lead enterprise Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) programs that improve developer productivity, platform reliability, operational readiness, and business delivery. This role partners across Engineering, Architecture, Product, Security, Risk, Finance, Operations, and application teams to translate platform strategy into actionable roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable execution.

Key Responsibilities

Lead cross-functional planning, prioritization, sequencing, and delivery for high-impact PaaS platform programs, ensuring alignment across platform services, consuming application teams, and enterprise priorities.

Define and manage platform roadmaps, dependencies, risks, milestones, adoption plans, governance checkpoints, and executive-level status reporting.

Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk, Operations, and Finance to ensure platform investments support scalability, reuse, compliance, resiliency, cost efficiency, and measurable business value.

Establish and track platform KPIs, including adoption, reliability, developer experience, time-to-market, operational health, supportability, and cost efficiency.

Drive delivery excellence through agile, iterative, and outcome-oriented practices, ensuring programs are supported by clear documentation, adoption playbooks, readiness plans, and post-launch learning.

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders by translating technical priorities, delivery tradeoffs, platform risks, and investment decisions into clear business outcomes.

Promote consistent platform consumption, standards, best practices, and change readiness across application teams and internal platform stakeholders.

Evaluate emerging platform technologies, automation capabilities, developer tools, and operational practices that improve delivery speed, reliability, and developer experience.

Qualifications

10+ years of experience leading enterprise technology, program management, or platform portfolios with ownership of complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Strong understanding of enterprise platform capabilities, including developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, shared services, APIs, container platforms, integration services, and core enterprise systems.

Demonstrated ability to partner with architecture and engineering leaders while maintaining a customer-, business-, and outcome-oriented perspective.

Proven track record delivering high-impact programs in ambiguous environments while managing dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and measurable outcomes.

Strong influence and communication skills, with the ability to align technical, business, security, compliance, and operations stakeholders.

Experience with agile, lean, and iterative delivery models applied to platform or enterprise-scale initiatives.

Ability to build and present executive-ready roadmaps, dashboards, adoption plans, and impact stories using tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Jira, Aha!, or similar platforms.

Preferred Experience & Certifications

Experience with PaaS capabilities such as container platforms, messaging, workflow orchestration, API management, file exchange, databases, caching, identity, certificate management, monitoring, and infrastructure automation.

General Familiarity with Infrastructure and Platform services and their purpose like Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, Terraform, CI/CD platforms, observability tooling, and enterprise service management practices.

Preferred certifications include SAFe, PMP, PMI-PgMP, Certified Scrum Professional, cloud platform certifications, or relevant product/program management credentials.

You will design, scale, drive adoption and own the unified program architecture and you’ll be accountable for integration adoption, tier progression, and partner engagement. This role will require a true builder. 

This is a principal-level, high-visibility mandate with ownership across the commercial strategy for how Intuit grows and monetizes the longtail of ISV partners, and the programs that scale it. You'll operate at the intersection of Product, Partner Development, Enablement, Marketing, Support, Legal, and Data; shaping decisions across all of them without owning any of them directly, and you'll own the growth, adoption, and economics of that channel, not on how many workstreams you touched. A bar raising strategy here starts with a genuine, first-hand understanding of partner needs and is built to win for Intuit, win for partners, and win for the shared customer. This is a critical hire: the unified program's success rides on getting that strategy right.



Responsibilities

Strategy & Program Design

  • Define program architecture, business rules, success metrics, and governance in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Translate platform strategy and partner insights into concrete programmatic capabilities that scale globally.
  • Develop and execute adoption strategies that drive customer growth, partner engagement and sustained usage across all phases of the unified Partner Program rollout.
  • Drive adoption, growth, and scale across the long tail of ISV partners, while improving partner sentiment and experience, through tiering, self-serve enablement, and automated benefit delivery.
  • Ground every program decision in direct partner input - economics, feedback, and behavior
  • Lead the strategy, design, eligibility and operating plan for scaling complex partner-facing initiatives including commercial models, tiering and benefits, incentives, enablement, and support.
  • Build API access into the ISV program as a foundational benefit.


Launch Planning & Execution

  • Drive end-to-end planning and rollout for new or evolving program features, partner readiness, and internal visibility, while serving as a trusted adviser for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Build business requirements documentation (BRDs), sequencing logic, drive alignment and plan phased rollout in partnership with technical and other cross functional stakeholders.
  • Partner with Program PMs and cross-functional teams to migrate existing partners (e.g., IAPP, MC Tech) into the new program structure.
  • Manage phased rollout and onboarding experiences for net-new partners, ensuring alignment with benefits, systems readiness, and communications.
  • Lead readiness reviews and status tracking across product, enablement, and support teams to ensure operational alignment at each stage of the rollout.


Partner Experience & Operational Development

  • Own the end to end partner journey onboarding, activation, benefits, support, and how it's tracked, partnering with internal tooling teams (PRM, Billing) to govern workflows that give real-time visibility and delightful partner experiences.
  • Set the bar for partner education and engagement, working with Partner Marketing and Enablement to ship it.
  • Serve as the central liaison across GTM, Ops, and Partner-facing teams to surface gaps in readiness or friction in adoption workflows. Close the loop on partner and support feedback by turning them into iteration and roadmap decisions.
  • Lead operational integration for strategic program capabilities (e.g., performance tracking, point systems, benefit redemptions), and hold GTM, Ops, and partner-facing teams accountable for closing identified gaps.


Business Operations & Measurement

  • Define and maintain KPIs to evaluate program effectiveness across dimensions such as partner engagement, activation, tier progression, or adoption/usage.
  • Partner with Data, Analytics, and Rev Ops to align telemetry, dashboards, and reporting pipelines to business objectives.
  • Synthesize metrics into actionable insights for program leadership, and influence roadmap prioritization based on partner adoption trends.
  • Own the channel's unit economics, cost-to-serve model - cost per partner, cost per tier, cost of benefit delivery - and hold the line on channel profitability as adoption and scale increase, not just top-line growth.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

  • Shape decisions in strategic planning forums and cross-functional working groups - not just attend them.
  • Drive alignment across legal, finance, product, enablement, and partner-facing teams to ensure policy adherence and system integrity.
  • Lead internal change management around new program rules, lifecycle updates, or incentive frameworks.
  • Lead the narrative in executive briefings, WBRs, QBRs, and partner council forums, bringing adoption insights and partner sentiment signals to the table.
  • Own the Partner Council end to end including charter, cadence, and agenda, and represent Intuit at industry events and conferences as the face of the ISV partner ecosystem.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in partner program strategy, GTM operations, channel/platform strategy, or non-technical product management - ideally with direct exposure to ISV/platform partnership economics (build-vs-integrate decisions, developer experience, usage-based or revenue-share models). 
  • Program Building: Direct experience building a partner program completely from scratch (writing and driving alignment around the v1 strategy paper, setting foundational assumptions, and executing the launch).
  • Track record of owning the P&L for the long-tail segment of the channel including cost to serve, unit economics by partner, cost per tier, cost of benefit delivery and support, and margin by tier, including rebate envelopes, run-rate floors/ceilings, and anti-stack rules.
  • Partner Economics & Profitability: Hold the line on profitability as adoption and scale increase, while influencing the channel's overall P&L so growth is economically sound across the portfolio.
  • Fluency in SaaS commercial models - Affiliate/Referral, Revenue Share, Reseller, Margin-Based  - and how each changes partner behavior and program design.
  • A demonstrated track record of building programmatic mechanisms - tiering, self-serve enablement, automated benefit delivery - that grow a long tail of ISV partners without a linear increase in headcount. You’ve scaled a partner ecosystem. 
  • Strategic Problem Solving: a genuinely ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problem you framed and solved from a blank page - not a pre-scoped roadmap you executed. 
  • Results Oriented: a track record of owning a growth or acceleration metric end-to-end and hitting it, with a bias to action over process for its own sake. 
  • Boundaryless Influence: a specific instance of mobilizing Legal, Product, Enablement, and Finance to break a cross-functional deadlock - without direct authority over any of them. 
  • Experience with Salesforce, PRMs, Airtable, Asana, or Confluence is a plus
  • Bonus: experience scaling a tiered partner program globally with regulatory compliance and revenue recognition in mind.

Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

Über Rotzinger Transver

Rotzinger Transver mit Standorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf in der Schweiz ist ein führender Anbieter von Lösungen für Produktflusssteuerung, Pufferung, Verteilung und Fördertechnik für die Lebensmittel-, Süsswaren- und Verpackungsindustrie.

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Mit modularen, skalierbaren und hygienischen Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, Produktverluste zu reduzieren, Stillstandszeiten zu minimieren und die Gesamtanlageneffektivität (OEE) zu steigern. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden.

Weitere Informationen über Rotzinger Transver und unser umfassendes Leistungsspektrum finden Sie auf der Website: www.rotzingertransver.com.

Rotzinger Transver ist Teil von Coesia, einer weltweit tätigen Unternehmensgruppe für innovative Industrie- und Verpackungslösungen mit Hauptsitz in Bologna. Coesia ist in 34 Ländern vertreten, vereint 21 Unternehmen und beschäftigt per 2026 mehr als 8'000 Mitarbeitende weltweit.

Über die Rolle

Als Head of Project Management (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für das Projektportfolio an unseren Produktionsstandorten in Kaiseraugst und Altendorf. To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About the Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process.
