The team is organized across three verticals: Global Energy Strategy (GES), which leads the development of innovative commercial structures to meet capacity demand and AWS's carbon-free energy commitments; Power Generation Solutions (PGS), the single-threaded owner for AWS power generation and energy engineering — delivering capacity solutions aligned with AWS's availability, reliability, sustainability, and redundancy requirements and managing the production readiness lifecycle of AWS-owned or commissioned generation and storage assets; and Energy Portfolio Operations (EPO), which owns Amazon's global renewable PPA portfolio and AWS CFE supply agreements. Global Energy partners closely with regional data center planning and delivery, global sustainability, and broader Amazon business units on energy procurement and infrastructure needs.

About the Role

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the PGS leadership team, you will report directly to the Head of Power Generation Solutions and serve as a strategic partner to PGS and Global Energy leadership. This is a dual-scope role: you will own technical program management for one of PGS's power programs, while also driving cross-cutting strategy, controllership, and operational mechanisms for PGS and the broader Global Energy organization.

You will work at the intersection of technical execution and business strategy, partnering with PGS engineering leads, Global Energy Principals, Energy Portfolio Operations, Finance, and senior AWS leadership to ensure our programs are on track, our organization is scaled appropriately, and our strategy is clear and actionable. You'll engage external partners, facilitate senior executive interactions, and serve as a trusted voice for PGS in cross-organizational forums.

This role is right for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks big, and can operate with equal fluency in a technical design review and a VP-level strategy session.

About You

You have a track record of delivering complex, ambiguous programs at scale — and doing it with the business acumen and executive presence to bring senior leaders along. You are data-driven but not data-bound; you know when to go deep and when to synthesize. You write clearly, speak directly, and earn trust quickly across organizational boundaries.

You are energized by consequential work. AWS's power strategy is shaping how the world's infrastructure gets built — and this role sits at the center of it.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs with senior leadership visibility

Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to translate data into strategic recommendations

Excellent written and verbal communication skills; experience preparing materials for VP-level audiences

Key job responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Own technical program management for part of the AWS power program, including pipeline management, milestone tracking, senior leader engagement, and vendor coordination.

Partner with the Head of PGS to develop and maintain a multi-year strategic roadmap for Global Energy, translating long-term priorities into annual execution plans with clear owners and accountability mechanisms.

Lead Global Energy controllership mechanisms, including headcount and resource planning, hiring performance tracking, and operating cadence — ensuring leadership has timely, accurate visibility into organizational health and delivery status.

Develop and manage reporting for senior leadership on program status, strategic initiatives, and organizational metrics; synthesize complex inputs into clear, decision-ready narratives.

Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, and partner delivery organizations to ensure Global Energy's full scope of needs is represented in cross-organizational planning.

Drive continuous improvement in Global Energy's operating mechanisms — identifying gaps, proposing solutions, and leading implementation across teams.

Represent PGS and Global Energy in senior forums, including facilitating off-sites, leadership reviews, and partner engagements inside and outside AWS.

Champion a high-performance team culture: model strong judgment, clear communication, and a bias for action.

About the team

The Power Generation Solutions team creates and delivers product and engineering solutions in for power and energy to help advance AWS’ mission to deliver world-leading cloud services. Our solutions are guided by four main principles; unlocking capacity growth, maintaining high infrastructure uptime, minimizing infrastructure costs, and advancing our net-zero carbon Climate Pledge. To deliver these solutions, our team provides technical input to realize a shared vision and strategy with partner teams and provides engineering support across the project or product lifecycle to deliver the solution. We also provide grid analytics and manage and develop models for determining the total energy and water use within our fleet of data centers and work with partners on improving overall performance. 

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- Experience working in a program management capacity and/or leading large-scale complex projects

- Experience providing and effectively communicating strategic and tactical recommendations based on data

- Experience in verbal and written communication for executive level leaders

- 7+ years of experience in technical program management, strategy, or related fields in a large-scale infrastructure, energy, or technology organization

Preferred Qualifications

- MBA, or Advanced degree

- Experience in energy, power generation, or data center infrastructure

- Familiarity with nuclear energy development, permitting, or procurement processes

- Experience in organizational planning, headcount modeling, or operational controllership

ou will ensure hardware design and deliverables align with the STC and OEM requirements for key builds. AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones give AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, and they make those systems more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center or multi data center infrastructures. Would you like to join the team that plans and delivers the network builds behind that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?

Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) runs a Delivery function that owns the end to end delivery picture across our telecommunication network infrastructure programs. We are looking for a technically strong Technical Infrastructure Program Manager to run a portfolio of network builds from planning through completion. You will prioritize work based on customer needs and target dates, make sure deliverables come together across teams, and build integrated delivery plans that carry each build to handover.

You will hold the single, trusted view of delivery status across the program, form a clear position on risk and priority, and recommend decisions to leadership. You will own a portfolio of builds, bring teams to one shared view of status, and drive the prioritization decisions and trade-offs that keep delivery on track. You will give confident, data-backed updates to senior leaders and partner across many teams to move work forward.

You work well in ambiguity. You set up structure, standardize what you can, and improve the process as you go. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, and you hold a portfolio view rather than get pulled into managing every task. If you want to shape how a global infrastructure program delivers, we would like to talk to you.

Key job responsibilities

- Own portfolio management across the program, prioritizing builds and reporting integrated status to leadership

- Drive the implementation of large-scale telecommunication infrastructure deployments on a global scale

- Collaborate with stakeholder teams to gather telecommunication infrastructure deployment requirements

- Develop and maintain process documentation

- Program manage from intake, engineering, business development, material acquisition, deployment, and closeout

- Provide deployment support for projects, augmenting the local region TIPM across the globe

- Create and maintain performance dashboards and KPIs to measure program effectiveness

- Drive process improvements through data analysis and stakeholder feedback

- Lead regular executive updates and cross-functional team communications

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience

- 5+ years of working cross functionally across several teams experience, or a MBA and 5+ years of program or project management experience

- Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams

- Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)

- Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

- 5+ years of technical infrastructure or program management experience for data center or telecommunications infrastructure

- Excellence in stakeholder management and executive communication

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process

- Strong understanding of fiber optic and pre-terminated fiber design, construction, and Outside Plant installation

Description

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead regulatory, functional safety, compliance, and road-readiness programs for Amazon’s autonomous delivery vehicle initiative. This role will own the integrated program required to safely develop, test, and deploy autonomous vehicles on public roads, working across vehicle engineering, autonomy software, systems engineering, functional safety, legal, regulatory compliance, public policy, operations, and commercial teams. The Senior TPM will also manage complex dependencies with external autonomy providers, vehicle manufacturers, suppliers, and other technology partners, ensuring that safety requirements, regulatory obligations, technical evidence, and operational controls remain aligned across organizational boundaries. The successful candidate will bring strong systems thinking and technical program leadership, translate safety and regulatory requirements into executable plans, drive closure of cross-functional risks and gaps, and establish the mechanisms used to determine when vehicles, software releases, operating locations, and operational processes are ready for public-road testing and deployment.

Key job responsibilities

Regulatory, Safety, and Compliance Program: Own the integrated roadmap for functional safety, regulatory compliance, and public-road readiness across vehicle development, testing, and deployment. Translate requirements into technical deliverables, milestones, owners, dependencies, and approval criteria.

Functional Safety and Technical Evidence: Partner with functional safety, systems engineering, and validation teams to coordinate hazard and risk assessments, safety requirements, verification and validation activities, and the technical evidence required to support the safety case and demonstrate compliance.

Road Readiness: Establish and drive readiness criteria for vehicles, software releases, operating locations, and operational processes. Coordinate closed-course and public-road testing, permits, operator readiness, incident-response processes, and required safety and regulatory approvals.

Cross-Functional and Partner Execution: Align engineering, functional safety, legal, regulatory compliance, public policy, operations, and commercial teams. Manage shared plans and complex dependencies with autonomy providers, vehicle manufacturers, suppliers, and other external partners.

Risk, Change, and Governance: Identify and drive closure of safety, regulatory, technical, and operational risks. Establish governance mechanisms to assess how hardware, software, operating-domain, supplier, and operational changes affect the safety case, compliance posture, and readiness to operate.

Program Reporting and Scalability: Provide senior leaders with clear readiness assessments, risk summaries, and decision points. Build repeatable processes and governance mechanisms that support expansion across vehicle platforms, deployment locations, and regulatory jurisdictions.

title: Senior Portfolio Operations Manager, Games
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

Netflix Games is looking for a Senior Portfolio Operations Manager to build the tools, data solutions, and rhythms that keep our games portfolio clear to the teams who support it. You'll design scalable tools and workflows, use AI to cut manual work and improve reporting, and lead the change management that lets the business adapt quickly.

Netflix Games is building the next generation of games for a worldwide audience. The Games portfolio sits where many teams across Netflix meet: Content, Marketing, Legal, Technology, Discovery, and more. Portfolio Operations Management is the connective tissue that keeps those teams in sync with what's happening across the portfolio.

We don't direct how games are made. We support the layer around them. We run shared portfolio tooling, keep portfolio state visible through reporting and monitoring, set and share the frameworks and standards that cross team boundaries, and help Games Leadership and cross-functional partners turn their needs into working processes.

The ideal candidate lives at the crossroads of program management and data solutions: equally comfortable leading a cross-functional program and designing the data model that powers it. You can effectively translate game production and development for non-production audiences, giving partners in Legal, Marketing, Finance, and Business Development the context they need to act. You'll develop, support, and improve the relational systems our partners rely on as their source of truth, find where AI and automation can remove friction, and deliver solutions that keep teams effortlessly connected. You're comfortable with ambiguity, you build trusting partnerships, and you prefer lightweight, scalable processes over heavy governance.

Responsibilities

Lead, scope, and operationalize cross-functional programs and projects involving multiple stakeholders with limited oversight.

Build and maintain scalable tools and workflows in our relational Airtable database: develop data models, build automations, and design interfaces.

Run regular audits to consolidate or retire redundant fields, tables, views, and automations, keeping systems performant, secure, and easy to navigate.

Use AI tools and agents for operational efficiency, workflow optimization, and intuitive reporting. Find high-leverage opportunities, prototype quickly, and bring proven solutions into production.

Improve portfolio reporting and data monitoring so Games Leadership and partners have accurate, timely visibility to ground and support their decisions.

Translate game production and development concepts (lifecycle phases, gates, milestones, live operations) into clear, actionable context for Games Leadership and non-production partners.

Own data hygiene and accuracy across the tools you support. Monitor health, fix what's broken, and help users serve themselves.

Turn a partner's need into a working process. Know when a tool, automation, playbook, workflow, report, or ritual is the right answer.

Own change management for rollouts, updates, and deprecations: testing, communication, training, adoption, and support - each grounded in a clear what, who, and why with confirmed buy-in.

Bring prioritized, evidence-backed feature requests and user stories to internal tooling and platform product and engineering owners on behalf of the portfolio.

Scope incoming work with discipline. Prioritize work that supports multiple users and that is backed by clear business objectives.

Write durable runbooks, training, and documentation so systems and rhythms outlast any one person.

Requirements

8+ years in operations, program management, business systems, or a related field. Games experience preferred, but not required.

Hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases and the workflows built on them. Advanced Airtable experience (schema design, linked records, automations, scripting, interfaces) strongly preferred.

A track record of building scalable internal tools, automations, or reporting that other teams enthusiastically adopt and rely on.

Practical experience using AI tools (LLMs, agents, AI-assisted automation) to improve operations, workflows, or reporting, with good judgment about where AI adds value and where it doesn't.

Strong data skills: modeling, hygiene, and turning raw data into clear, decision-ready reporting. SQL, scripting (JavaScript or Python), or BI tool experience is a plus.

Knowledge of data governance principles, data quality standards, and metadata management.

Proven change management skills, landing rollouts across many stakeholders with measurable adoption.

Ability to translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements and user stories for product and engineering teams.

Clear, proactive communicator who builds lasting partnerships across leadership, production, development, and highly matrixed cross-functional teams.

Comfortable with ambiguity, with a people-over-process mindset and a bias toward lightweight, adoptable solutions.

 
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $170,000.00 - $250,000.00.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here. 

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Experience collaborating with Asia-based manufacturing suppliers to ensure quality and maintain strong partnerships.
Proven ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams, promoting collaboration among diverse individuals with varying levels of expertise.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts, create comprehensive documentation, and deliver impactful presentations.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and deliver results in fast-paced environments.

You own silicon bring-up schedule from power on to production release

Lead prototype chip delivery to internal customers

Track and coordinate engineering deliverables, key milestones and qualification/validation tasks in the new product introduction phase

Communicate status to cross-functional teams as well as upper management

Continuously evaluate internal tools and processes and drive fixes to improve productivity

Create new and fix existing processes between different teams

Drive implementation of SW tools for data analytics and process evaluation

BS degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering or related (or equivalent experience)

Deep understanding of ASIC Technology and Productization requirements

Proficient with MS Project and Excel

Senior TPM International Certification, Prime Air

Job ID: 10589304 | Amazon.com Services LLC

Apply now

Description

Prime Air is seeking a Technical Program Manager to drive airworthiness certification programs for the MK30 unmanned aircraft system. You will own the plans, schedules, and compliance tracking that turn certification strategy into execution. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and regulatory compliance. You will coordinate across software, hardware, systems, and test teams to keep certification deliverables on track and surface risks early.

A key dimension of this role is international regulatory coordination. Prime Air operates across multiple countries, each with its own aviation authority and certification expectations. You will manage the programs that drive international approvals of the drone system. You will track regulatory deltas across jurisdictions and maximize reuse of compliance evidence, so each country is not run as a separate program.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Engineering Certification.

Key job responsibilities

Own the plans, schedules, and compliance matrices for Prime Air's certification programs across DO-178C (software), DO-254 (hardware), and DO-160G (environmental qualification).

Track certification objectives against engineering deliverables. Identify gaps and dependencies early, and drive them to closure.

Partner with engineering teams to sequence certification work within the development lifecycle. Escalate schedule and resource risks to leadership.

Build and maintain the status reporting, metrics, and dashboards that give leadership visibility into certification progress

Coordinate the programs that support regulatory engagement across the markets Prime Air operates in (EASA, CASA, DGCA, CAA, JCAB, and others).

Track regulatory requirements and deltas across authorities. Manage the evidence reuse plan that supports bilateral validation processes (for example, FAA-to-EASA) to reduce international approval timelines.

Monitor emerging regulations (for example, EU U-Space, FAA BVLOS rulemaking) and fold new requirements into program plans before they become blockers.

Drive alignment across engineering, regulatory, and certification teams on scope, milestones, and means of compliance.

Support the Senior Manager and certification engineers in preparing compliance arguments and documentation for the FAA, EASA, and international DERs/CVEs.

Establish and improve the program mechanisms that scale certification delivery as Prime Air expands internationally.

About the team

This is a new organization within Prime Air to own the technical execution of certification to support our world-wide expansion focus in 2027 and beyond.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership

- Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps

- Experience in industry work in a related environment

Sr. Operations TPM, Leo Electronic Supply Chain

Job ID: 10589299 | Amazon Kuiper Manufacturing Enterprises LLC

Apply now

Description

Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite broadband network. Its mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet to customers and communities around the world, and we’ve designed the system with the capacity, flexibility, and performance to serve a wide range of customers, from individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The Amazon Leo Electronic Supply Chain team is seeking an Operations Technical Program Manager to drive technical manufacturing and supply chain operations for Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBA) destined for our satellites. The successful candidate will manage contract manufacturers' end-to-end production processes and work with internal customers like design and reliability engineering while maintaining a focus on quality and delivery requirements.

Key job responsibilities

• Manage contract manufacturers' end-to-end production process for assigned PCBAs

• Manage roadmaps and schedules for the PCBAs and various build

• Take on projects and programs to improve org-wide initiatives, e.g., cycle time and quality metrics

• Ensure on-time delivery to meet Amazon Leo production rate requirements

• Drive production planning and execution aligned with cross-functional priorities

• Measure, Control and Improve capacity, quality, manufacturing rate/processes, and delivery KPIs at contract manufacturers

• Lead technical deep dives to resolve manufacturing blockers and constraints

• Balance development and engineering needs to minimize production impacts

• Implement continuous improvement initiatives to optimize production efficiency

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and mitigate supply chain risks

• Develop and maintain supplier performance metrics and reporting systems

NOTE: This role requires the ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 25% of the time

A day in the life

As an Operations TPM at Amazon Leo, you'll start your day reviewing upcoming deliveries, blockers and constraints, and production metrics across your contract manufacturers. You'll participate in daily production meetings to address, update and escalate immediate issues, working with cross functional partners. Throughout the day, you'll analyze production performance data to identify bottlenecks, conduct deep-dive investigations into constraints, and work with suppliers to implement process improvements.

You will partner with engineering teams on technical reviews to evaluate new design requirements, impact analysis, manufacturing challenges, and schedule trade-offs. You'll regularly present performance updates to leadership, support Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews, and lead projects, collaborating with peers, that will improve org-wide initiatives. The role requires a balance of tactical execution and strategic thinking to ensure both daily delivery and long-term manufacturing capability needs are met.

About the team

At Amazon, we embrace our differences and are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we're building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We operate with high standards and a strong sense of ownership, working backwards from our customers' needs to deliver innovative solutions in satellite manufacturing.

Basic Qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience, or a Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of supply chain experience

- 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

- Experience leading cross-functional projects and managing large, complicated programs

- Experience in root cause analysis and error correction, identifying changes to procedures and systems to implement long-term fixes and avoid repeating issues

- Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and make data-driven decisions

- Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines, or experience in a fast-paced, high-tech company

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or Bachelor's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration

- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma

- Technical understanding of PCBA manufacturing processes and materials, capacity assessments, and quality requirements

- Direct experience managing high-complexity electronics contract manufacturers, preferably in aerospace or defense industries

- Demonstrated success in implementing advanced manufacturing processes and quality systems in regulated industries

- Deep expertise in space-grade electronics manufacturing, including familiarity with J-STD-001 Space Addendum, IPC-A-610 Space Addendum, and AS9100 requirements

About the role:

	Driving strategic initiatives and delivering exceptional results, the PMO Manager oversees a portfolio of IT programs — from M&A integrations and enterprise platform rollouts to cross-functional product, infrastructure, data, and security initiatives, as well as internal initiatives that improve and standardize how Technology plans and delivers work — ensuring alignment with organizational goals and efficient execution. This role involves leading a talented team of Program Managers, shaping portfolio strategy and governance, and advancing an AI-enabled approach to program and portfolio management. You'll partner closely with a fellow PMO Manager to lead the PMO as one team, sharing standards, priorities, and the assignment of work across Program Managers.

	What's in it for you:
	* Competitive compensation, benefits package and perks
	* Advancement opportunities with aggressive and structured career paths
	* TQL's IT Team offers a hybrid work environment with the ability to work remotely 40 hours per month
	* Access to the latest emerging technologies
	* Reimbursement for continuous education and technical training
	* We win wherever we go - Voted a 2019-2024 Computerworld Best Places to Work in IT 

	What you'll be doing:
	* Monitor and manage a portfolio of complex, cross-functional IT programs, including M&A integrations, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.
	* Partner with Product and Technology leaders to maintain a clear view of in-flight and planned work, aligning programs to business outcomes and supporting prioritization decisions.
	* Provide visibility into how capacity is committed across teams, balancing workload and surfacing constraints and dependencies to inform planning.
	* Establish and monitor right-sized intake, tiering, and governance practices that reinforce department standards and drive consistency and accountability in delivery.
	* Identify, assess, and mitigate program risks to minimize impact on program outcomes.
	* Leverage the PMO's system of record and AI tools to deliver transparent, accurate, and timely portfolio insights to IT and business leadership.
	* Facilitate clear and consistent communication with program stakeholders, providing regular updates on program status and performance.
	* Continuously evaluate and improve program management processes, tools, and data quality to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
	* Lead, coach, and upskill the program management team, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and excellence.

	What you need:
	* Proven experience in IT program management and people leadership, with a track record of successfully managing complex, cross-functional programs and leading PMO functions; M&A integration experience a plus.
	* PMP (Project Management Professional), Agile certifications (e.g., Certified ScrumMaster, PMI-ACP), or similar certifications preferred.
	* Bachelor's degree in business, management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
	* In-depth understanding of program and portfolio management methodologies, governance, and capacity planning, including project portfolio management tools; experience applying AI to reporting and decision-making a plus.
	* Strong leadership, communication, influencing, coaching, and organizational skills. Adept at defining and implementing new processes, driving their adoption, and using data to inform decisions.
	* Self-driven owner who works independently and is comfortable navigating ambiguity. Thrives in a fast-paced environment and motivated to solve challenging problems.

	Where you'll be: 4289 Ivy Pointe Blvd. Cincinnati, OH 45245

	Employment visa sponsorship is unavailable for this position. Applicants requiring employment visa sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., F-1 STEM OPT, H-1B, TN, J1 etc.) will not be considered.

description:
Product Manager – Storage Solutions Portfolio Planner

Overview

We are seeking a highly strategic and technically proficient Product Manager - Storage Hardware Portfolio Planner to drive the roadmap, portfolio strategy, and lifecycle management of storage systems deployed across large-scale server infrastructure environments. This role sits at the intersection of product management, supply chain, engineering, datacenter infrastructure, and business planning.

The ideal candidate will define storage portfolio strategy, evaluate emerging technologies, balance cost and performance tradeoffs, and develop long-range plans that enable scalable, reliable, and cost-effective server deployments. This individual will work closely with silicon vendors, storage suppliers, server hardware engineering teams, datacenter architects, capacity planners, operations, and finance teams.

Key Responsibilities

Storage Portfolio Strategy & Planning

· Own the end-to-end storage hardware portfolio strategy supporting datacenter infra

· Develop multi-year storage roadmaps aligned with business growth, infrastructure requirements, and technology transitions.

· Evaluate and recommend investment strategies across HDD, SSD, NVMe, computational storage, and emerging storage technologies.

· Build portfolio plans that balance performance, reliability, cost, power, sustainability, and supply continuity objectives.

· Drive generation-to-generation technology transitions and retirement strategies.

Product & Technology Management

· Define storage product requirements and platform adoption plans across server hardware programs.

· Partner with solution architects and engineering teams to establish future storage requirements and technology needs.

· Analyze industry trends, supplier roadmaps, technology advancements, and competitive offerings.

· Lead business cases for new storage technologies and architecture

· Develop cost models and performance/value assessments for portfolio decisions.

Supplier & Ecosystem Management

· Engage directly with storage component and subsystem suppliers to influence roadmaps and secure strategic alignment.

· Evaluate supplier capabilities, capacity plans, manufacturing readiness, and technology differentiation.

· Drive supplier selection recommendations based on technical, commercial, and operational criteria.

· Support strategic negotiations and sourcing decisions alongside procurement and supply chain teams.

· Maintain deep understanding of industry dynamics, market risks, and supply-demand outlooks.

Demand, Capacity & Lifecycle Planning

· Translate infrastructure growth forecasts into storage portfolio demand plans.

· Develop long-term supply and capacity strategies to support business requirements.

· Identify supply chain risks and develop mitigation strategies.

· Ensure continuity of supply during technology migrations and business scaling events.

Cross-Functional Leadership

· Lead cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, operations, finance, sourcing, quality, and suppliers.

· Drive executive reviews and portfolio decision-making processes.

· Present recommendations and tradeoff analyses to senior leadership.

· Establish portfolio KPIs and measure business outcomes.

· Influence stakeholders across multiple organizations without direct authority.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Business, or related technical discipline.

· 8+ years of experience in product management, hardware planning, infrastructure strategy, supply chain planning, or related fields.

· Experience with server, storage, or datacenter hardware technologies.

· Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.

· Experience developing business cases, investment analyses, and technology roadmaps.

· Experience leading complex cross-functional programs.

· Strong communication and executive presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

· MBA or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Operations, or Business.

· 10+ years of experience within cloud infrastructure, hyperscale datacenters, OEMs, storage suppliers, or server hardware organizations.

· Deep understanding of:

o SSD and HDD technologies

o NVMe architectures

o Enterprise storage systems

o Server platforms

o Storage reliability and qualification methodologies

o Storage performance benchmarking

o Datacenter infrastructure economics

· Experience with supplier management and strategic sourcing.

· Knowledge of semiconductor and storage industry roadmaps.

· Experience evaluating ROI and lifecycle cost models.

· Familiarity with sustainability, power, and thermal considerations impacting storage deployments.

Desired Competencies

· Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.

· Ability to balance technical, operational, and financial tradeoffs.

· Executive presence and strong stakeholder management skills.

· Data-driven decision maker.

· Exceptional influencing and negotiation capabilities.

· Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive alignment across diverse teams.

· Strong understanding of market dynamics and supplier ecosystems.

· Results-oriented with a focus on execution and operational excellence.

This role is ideal for a product leader who can combine deep infrastructure expertise, commercial acumen, and long-range planning to shape the future of storage hardware across large-scale server deployments.

Description

It’s a new Day 1 for Leo, and we are looking for team members to join the Accounting PMO supporting this emerging business.

This position supports the launch and expansion of Amazon Leo by contributing to strategic initiatives that help grow and scale the business. You will support controllership and scalability as you partner with global stakeholders — including business product managers, financial technology teams, accounting operations, business finance, tax, treasury, and others — to deliver highly scalable, secure, and flexible financial solutions. You operate effectively in a fast-paced, global, results-oriented environment. Strong oral and written communication skills are essential, along with the ability to think clearly, analyze quantitatively, problem-solve, scope business requirements, and prioritize.

Successful candidates bring experience across three disciplines: Accounting, Program Management, and Financial Systems Implementation. This role requires financial accounting knowledge, experience working with technology teams to design and build financial systems integration solutions, and the ability to support the launch and ongoing management of a financial integration program. You contribute to cross-functional decision-making and help drive implementation across a global scope, balancing time to market with investments in automation.

Key job responsibilities

• Support cross-functional programs: Contribute to new and evolving programs by supporting end-to-end implementation activities, developing processes, metrics, documentation, and communications, and driving continuous improvement.

• Partner with delivery teams: Collaborate with worldwide business, technology, and product teams to deliver high-quality program outcomes on time.

• Analyze and recommend: Gather data, analyze results, and provide feedback on priorities, timelines, and outcomes to support business process decisions and scale financial recordkeeping health.

• Communicate program status: Prepare clear updates and recommendations for stakeholders, translating complex information into actionable summaries for peers and leadership.

• Build relationships: Collaborate with business, product, accounting, technology, and finance owners globally to support scalable financial automation with the highest degree of controllership.

• Identify risks proactively: Surface potential issues early, propose mitigation options, and escalate appropriately to set the team up for success.

A day in the life

Your day typically begins with reviewing overnight readiness metrics and flagging critical issues that require attention.

Throughout the day, you:

• Track key readiness activities and follow up with teams on readiness status and test progress.

• Monitor test statistics, assist with testing activities, and validate accounting flows.

• Analyze accounting test results and prepare recommendations for your team lead and stakeholders.

• Provide guidance to partner delivery teams on accounting requirements and help drive issues to resolution — including identifying alternative solution options.

• Prepare data-driven inputs for leadership meetings, translating complex analytics into clear summaries.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, refine risk assessments for upcoming launches, and assist the Accounting team in resolving issues blocking deployment of Accounting features.

Our Finance team serves as a trusted partner to the business, providing the financial perspective leaders need to make informed decisions. We are a collaborative group that values analytical rigor, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where every team member can learn, contribute, and thrive.

- 3+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience

- Bachelor's degree in accounting or related field

- 2+ years of Fortune 500 operational accounting experience

- CPA

- Knowledge of GAAP research tools and the FASB codification

title: Portfolio Leader
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category
Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

About the Role

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

 

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today. 

The Builder Leadership Experience

Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale. 

AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.

Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.

What You'll Actually Be Building & Execution

Leadership & Team Excellence

Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.

Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.

Technical Strategy & Authority

Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.

Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.

Customer & Business Impact

Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.

Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.

Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.

You're Our Builder Lead If…

You Have Proven Leadership: 4+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.

You Bring Advanced Technical Depth: Deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.

You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.

You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.

You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

Nice-to-Haves

Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.

Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.

Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Strategic IT Portfolio Manager
description:
Job Details:

Job Description: 

The Role and Impact

Intel's Global IT organization is seeking an experienced Senior Strategic IT Portfolio Manager to lead portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and execution across a diverse portfolio of technology initiatives.

 

This role serves as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders, driving investment decisions, optimizing resource allocation, and ensuring technology programs deliver measurable business value. The successful candidate will establish portfolio governance processes, provide executive-level insights into portfolio performance, and influence strategic decisions that support Intel's technology transformation objectives.

 

This position requires exceptional analytical capabilities, business acumen, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed environment.

 

About the Team

The Global IT organization enables Intel's business through innovative technology solutions, operational excellence, and strategic transformation initiatives.

 

As part of the Enterprise and Technology Transformation Business Operations group, you will partner with technology, finance, and business stakeholders to drive portfolio optimization, strategic planning, governance excellence, and business outcomes across enterprise-wide IT investments.

 

What You’ll Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

 

Scenario Planning and Modeling: Build predictive resource, financial, and timeline models to simulate the impact of strategy changes, budget shifts, or project delays.

Strategic Prioritization: Manage the intake, evaluation, and prioritization of IT initiatives to ensure alignment with corporate goals.

Resource Capacity Planning: Analyze resource utilization and demand across the portfolio to optimize allocation and flag constraints.

Risk and Dependency Management: Track and mitigate cross-project dependencies, critical path items, and portfolio-level risks.

Performance Tracking: Monitor and report on the overall health, milestones, budget performance, and value delivery of all active IT projects.

 

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.

Executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders.

Data-driven decision maker.

Strong collaborator who excels in matrixed environments.

Skilled at navigating ambiguity and driving results.

Continuous improvement mindset and passion for operational excellence.

 

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. 

See  Intel Benefits for more details. 

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. 

 

Note:

This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

 

Minimum Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related discipline.

7+ years of experience in the following:   

Experience with portfolio management, financial management, strategic planning, or business operations.

Portfolio management software and tools, with a proven ability to analyze data and present actionable insights.

Experience with budgeting, resource allocation, and risk management principles.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience:

Master's degree in a relevant field with at least 5 + years of experience OR PhD with 3+ years of experience.

Experience working in technology-driven environments or supporting IT initiatives.

Proven track record of successfully implementing prioritization frameworks and optimization techniques.

Certification in portfolio management, such as PfMP or an equivalent program.

Experience with Intel tools and systems.

 

Why This Role is Attractive

Opportunity to influence strategic technology investment decisions across Intel.

Direct exposure to executive leadership and enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.

Significant impact on prioritization, funding, governance, and successful delivery of technology programs.

Collaborative environment focused on innovation, transformation, continuous improvement, and business value creation.

          

Job Type:
Experienced Hire

Shift:
Shift 1 (United States of America)

Primary Location: 
US, Oregon, Hillsboro

Additional Locations:
US, Arizona, Phoenix, US, California, Santa Clara

Posting Statement:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance.

Position of Trust
N/A

Benefits

We offer a total compensation package that ranks among the best in the industry. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel. 

 

 
Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $188,330.00-265,870.00 USD
 

 
The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
 

 

Work Model for this Role
This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. * Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change.

*

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

 

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

 

What you'll do

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform, powering the next generation of hospitality operations. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor, working directly with our Platform Lead, who sets Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering organisation. It's a small team, so you'll cover a wide surface area, with no dedicated DevOps or QA function to hand work to.

This is a high-ownership seat. You'll take on substantial, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives, agree the direction with the Platform Lead, then drive them from first analysis through to completion with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a significant topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role. If you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

 

What you'll be up to 

  • Designing and building scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
  • Spotting and scoping problems and initiatives yourself, not just picking up assigned tickets: weighing impact, priority and timing.
  • Contributing to architectural decisions and design discussions, and bringing other teams along.
  • Driving substantial, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, coordinating with stakeholders across engineering.
  • Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that help teams deliver faster and more reliably.
  • Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
  • Sharing knowledge through code reviews, design reviews and pairing, and helping raise technical standards.
  • Spotting where AI and automation can improve how we build and run software.

 

Some of the challenges waiting for you 

You'll take ownership of one of these as your first initiative, with no other distractions.

  • Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database.
  • Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
  • Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform.
  • Extracting and reworking common services to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team 

  • 5+ years of backend development experience, with a track record of owning significant technical work from ambiguity through to completion.
  • Substantial hands-on ownership of infrastructure, reliability or performance, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms. We care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
  • Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals and genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
  • Comfort with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
  • Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests, as we don't have a dedicated QA function.
  • A project you can talk about in depth: the problem, what you did and the impact it had.
  • Fluent English.

Nice to have 

  • Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS or Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other approaches (like CloudFormation).
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ or SQS are good transferable equivalents).
  • Experience owning observability and logging for highly available systems.
  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
  • Experience mentoring other engineers, and introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

 

Culture & Growth

What We Offer 

  • An International Team: Work alongside colleagues from over 20 nationalities. 
  • Growth and Development: 360° feedback reviews, an evolving career framework and an annual learning budget of €1,000+. 
  • Autonomy and Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We trust you to make decisions and contribute directly. 
  • Real Impact: Join a fast-growing scale-up transforming hospitality. From day one, your work drives real impact. 
  • Fair Pay: Competitive salaries guided by benchmarking data, with recognition for performance and contribution.

Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions and help redefine the future of hospitality tech.
